fields.description: What it is called on the learner's profile — e.g. Water Chemistry Certified, Ten Courses Down.
fields.label: Badge

fields.description: Shown under the badge. Say what somebody did to earn it, not what the badge is — the learner already knows they have it.
fields.label: Description

fields.description: Added to the holder's total when the badge is awarded. The award copies this number, so re-pricing a badge later does not rewrite anybody's score.
fields.label: Points

fields.description: Unticking stops the badge being awarded from here on. Awards already made stand — a badge somebody earned is not withdrawn because the scheme changed.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: What the evaluator checks. Each type reads exactly one of the fields beside it and ignores the rest, which is why switching type clears the ones that no longer apply.
fields.label: Awarded For
fields.options:
Course Completed
Category Completed
Courses Completed Count
Streak Days
Perfect Score
First Completion

fields.description: The threshold, as a number — how many courses, or how many consecutive days.
fields.label: Threshold
